title: Michael Aquino says MJ meant non-human biologics in Space Command

tellings.quote: "Oh yeah, MJ, we had that in U that was in Space Command. We use that for non-aterrestrial biologics, right?"

plain: The letters "MJ", which appear in the MJ12 documents, papers describing a supposed secret group that handled the UFO matter, were used inside US Space Command as a label for non-human living beings, according to a man named Michael Aquino. The writer Peter Levenda, who studies the history of intelligence agencies, repeats what Aquino told him: "Oh yeah, MJ, we had that in... Space Command. We use that for non-terrestrial biologics." If true, it would tie those papers to a real military code for beings not from Earth.
